summary: Owner verification pass on the two connections, plus the requested NFT gallery. Discord login and wallet linking were exercised live rather than assumed: GET /api/auth/discord returns a 302 to Discord's authorize endpoint with the configured client id, and POST /api/wallet/challenge returns a signable ownership message bound to the session's Discord id and origin. GET /api/holdings already returns exactly the set the owner asked to extract — SEVEN GODS, OTOMO 精霊体/受肉体/童子 and SDT — so nothing was invented there. New: tapping an NFT holding opens a horizontally scrolling, snap-aligned gallery of the wallet's actual tokens. Enumeration uses tokensOfOwner on chain, then tokenURI on the first owned id to derive the metadata template, and reads name and image from that metadata; ids and art are never guessed from a pattern. SEVEN GODS supports neither tokensOfOwner nor ERC721Enumerable, so its card is labelled 個別表示は準備中 and returns supported:false instead of fabricating token ids. The metadata template and the image URL are both restricted to the storage.googleapis.com host that the Worker CSP was widened to allow, so a compromised metadata file cannot point the page at an arbitrary origin. The endpoint takes the wallet from the server-side player row only, never from the request, and 401s without a session. Verified live: 童子 2/2, 受肉体 4/4, 精霊体 84 with 12-per-page paging to the final page, images decoding at full resolution on the 375x812 viewport. 88 tests, lint, typecheck pass.

blockers.description: Stable Next and Miniflare still require Sharp 0.34.5, which npm audit flags for inherited libvips advisories. The built Worker has no Sharp or libvips import and the application has no untrusted image-processing path, so the documented owner-only non-reachable exception remains in force.
blockers.resolution_required: Upgrade when stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare officially support patched Sharp; reassess immediately if image upload or server-side untrusted processing is added.

blockers.description: The SEVEN GODS contract exposes neither tokensOfOwner nor ERC721Enumerable, and the public RPC caps eth_getLogs at 50,000 blocks, so owned GODS token ids cannot be enumerated by direct reads. The balance is shown truthfully and the per-token view is labelled 準備中 rather than populated with guessed ids.
blockers.resolution_required: Provide either an indexer endpoint or a deployment block height for chunked Transfer-log scanning before the GODS gallery is enabled.
